meta.name: dream-video-prompt-generator
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货短视频时，用本技能一键生成即梦视频中英文提示词。依托四大智能体协同与专属公式，确保人物与情绪高度一致，完美适配5s带货场景，高效产出高质量分镜脚本，让视频制作事半功倍！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入带货主题，生成数字人短视频的中英文分镜提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是电商运营或内容创作者，常做数字人带货短视频却苦于写提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into bilingual video prompts for digital-human selling clips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create digital-human selling videos and struggle with prompt writing.

howto.what: 它按「主体+运动+场景+镜头语言/光影/氛围」公式，为小省导购员数字人带货视频逐幕输出中英文即梦提示词，并附 Suno 音乐和 AI 绘画提示词。
howto.when: 当你需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的提示词时触发，涵盖产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等场景类型。

say.text: 帮我生成5幕产品推荐视频的即梦提示词，情绪走热情专业
say.note: 先核查知识库，匹配则直接返回已有模板

say.text: 做一套价格对比视频的5幕提示词，要中英文对照
say.note: 无匹配模板时按公式新生成，并做质量核查

say.text: 再给这5幕配一套Suno音乐和AI绘画提示词
say.note: 由跨环节适配师输出同源提示词

howto.what_en: It writes Jimeng prompts for Xiaosheng guide digital-human product videos, following the subject + movement + scene + shot/light/atmosphere formula per scene, with Chinese and English versions plus Suno music and AI painting prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need prompts for Xiaosheng guide digital-human product videos, covering product recommendation, price comparison and promotion scenes.

say_en.text: Generate 5-scene Jimeng prompts for a product recommendation video, warm tone
say_en.note: It checks the knowledge base and reuses a matching template

say_en.text: Make a 5-scene price comparison prompt set in Chinese and English
say_en.note: New prompts are created via the formula, then quality-checked

say_en.text: Add Suno music and AI painting prompts for these 5 scenes
say_en.note: The cross-tool agent outputs prompts from the same source
